changes.manual_retry: Explicit retry replaces deadline with now + the task seconds limit (default 3600); automatic provider retry, release and reclaim retain deadline. Existing limits, consumed usage and reservations remain unchanged. Exhausted consumption cannot be refunded by retry.
changes.resource_recovery: Copy the last checkpoint, keep sources and completed drafts, increment only incomplete resource spec revisions and enqueue new child jobs with renewed deadline. Superseded resources cannot be claimed or saved; their late provider usage can still settle. Old attempt checkpoint and artifacts remain diagnostic records.
changes.new_submission: Confirmed acceptance clears the pending request identity. A new explicit submission of the same text gets a fresh UUID. Uncertain network outcomes reuse the pending v2 UUID, including after refresh. Old v1 permanently saved identities are ignored. Progress restoration never automatically retries.

published_frontend_nginx.apis: scripted responses; frontend loaded through actual production Nginx

validation_setup_note: The first browser run hit an unrelated old preview already occupying port 5198 and failed against old UI. Replaced the test endpoint with a free port and verified served index equals the newly built index before rerunning; the verified build passed. Initial isolated replay omitted original child-job rows and correctly failed CHILD_JOB_MISSING; final replay copied the corresponding durable job records and passed.
